title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry from ElfLiq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is a deliciously sweet, rich and jammy blueberry flavour, but with a streak of sour on the exhale that lends it a an irresistibly moreish kick you’ll want to come back to again and again. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. This liquid is perfect for refillable vape and vape starter kit users.
